# KM-123 — Control cut: shrink to the M1 route surface

**Lane:** app · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-120, KM-122 · **Serializes with:** KM-130 (`composition/human/matrix.ts`, `handlers.ts`)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:**
- `apps/control/**`, except `apps/control/src/agent-join/**` (owned by KM-131 and KM-132)
- `tests/e2e/security/{relay,owner-cleanup-route,owner-review-route}.test.ts` (delete only)

## Outcome

The deployed control function registers only the M1 human routes listed below, plus the health route. Every other `/api/human/*` and `/api/agent/*` path returns 404 `not_found`. The agent-bootstrap, channel-access, channel-discovery, pairing, closure, owner-mailbox, owner-device-proof, revocation, room-send, device-admission and proof-key code is deleted, not hidden. The `KHALA_ADMISSION_MODE` branch is gone.

Kept route surface (exact):

| Method | Path |
|---|---|
| GET | `/api/health` (runtime) |
| GET | `/api/human/auth/login`, `/api/human/auth/callback`, `/api/human/me`, `/api/human/invitations/inspect` |
| POST | `/api/human/auth/logout`, `/api/human/invitations/share`, `/api/human/invitations/admit`, `/api/human/messaging/session` |
| POST | `/api/human/messaging/participants` (C3 entries after KM-122; no GET) |
| POST | `/api/human/channel-link/resolve`, `/api/human/channel-link/personal` |

## Context and evidence

- Plan U6 (goal, files and approach) and R13 ("deleted, not hidden"). Plan KTD5 keeps the server-side human invite+join path (`gateway.admit`, `apps/control/src/composition/human/matrix.ts:663-713`). That path needs `roomAuthority`/`rememberAuthority` (`:147-185`), so both stay.
- **Composition root:**
  - `apps/control/src/composition/hosted-production.ts:25-83` branches on `KHALA_ADMISSION_MODE` (`:29-33`).
  - It wires bootstrap, channel access, proof keys, discovery, closure and agent handlers (`:34-82`).
- **Discovery:**
  - `apps/control/src/runtime/discover.ts:36-57` lists the domains `human`, `closure` and `agent`.
  - `renderGeneratedFunction` (`:140-149`) uses `registerHostedProductionRoutes()` only when both `composition/human/handlers.ts` and `composition/agent/handlers.ts` exist.
  - **Therefore `composition/agent/handlers.ts` must stay**, as an empty agent-domain anchor. KM-133 adds the agent-join routes and relies on this (KM-133 Context).
- **Gateway behaviour:**
  - `createGateway` (`apps/control/src/runtime/handler.ts:173-194`) returns 404 `not_found` for an unregistered path when its prefix is present.
  - It returns 503 only for an absent prefix (`:192-193`).
  - With both domains present, every deleted path becomes 404.
- **Human handlers:**
  - `apps/control/src/composition/human/handlers.ts:428-489` register `unavailable*` placeholder routes and optional feature dependencies.
  - Imports `:19-23` pull in owner-mailbox, owner-device-proof, revocation, room-send and device-admission.
- **Matrix agent coupling:**
  - Kept file `matrix.ts` imports agent stores at `:2-4`.
  - It also carries agent-only members: `inspectOwnerDeviceKey` (`:327-352`), `inspectRoomSenderDevices` (`:551-634`) and `channelCreateFor` (`:716-773`), declared in `MatrixHumanServices` (`:84-93`, `:96`).
  - The only callers outside this file are in deleted code: `agent/production-bootstrap.ts:145,161-162`, `agent/channel-create.ts:42-46`, `agent/owner-device-proof.ts:40,401,504,527`, `agent/hosted-created-target.ts:10`, `human/hosted-channel-access*.ts`, `human/revocation.ts:29,85`.
- **Channel link:** `apps/control/src/channel-link/production.ts:41-89` (agent half) imports channel-discovery and hosted channel-access modules (`:2-3`, `:7-9`). The human half is `:14-38`. `handler.ts` has the agent route at `:15-20`, `:29-40`, `:86-116` and `:123`.
- **Invitations:** `apps/control/src/invitations/link.ts:22-63` (`resolveAgentChannelLink`) is used only by `channel-link/handler.ts:8,100`. `link.test.ts` tests only that function. Keep `inviteFromShareLink` (`:9-20`); KM-131 uses it.
- **Imports from outside control:** a root `pnpm typecheck` also compiles `tests/e2e/**` (`package.json:10`, `tests/e2e/harness/tsconfig.json`).
  - Three files there import code this ticket deletes: `tests/e2e/security/relay.test.ts:12`, `owner-cleanup-route.test.ts:4-5` and `owner-review-route.test.ts:4-8`.
  - `tests/integration/{closure-live.ts,owner-revocation-live.ts,recovery/*.mjs}` also import deleted code. They are not typechecked, and KM-124 deletes them, so leave them; KM-110 cites `closure-live.ts` as a pattern.
- The web stops calling the deleted routes in KM-120 (hard dependency).
  - `apps/web/src/composition/human/agent-presence.ts` calls `/api/agent/status`. After this ticket it gets 404, and that is acceptable.

## Scope

Delete the directories and files listed below, reduce the kept files to the human surface, and rewrite or delete their tests.

- Deleting `tests/**` (beyond the three e2e files), `apps/connector`, `packages/*` and `infra/preview`: KM-124. Pruning `packages/contracts` and `packages/messaging`: KM-125. Docs: KM-153.
- `publishedFingerprint` in the session response (`matrix.ts:304-325`, `:376`) stays; the web still decodes it.

## Contract and invariants

No C-section shape changes here. C1: control is `@khala/control` at `apps/control` and owns Netlify functions. KTD9: participant attribution reads the owner map, which KM-122 already did. Invariant: no kept file imports a deleted module, and `apps/control/package.json` exports no deleted directory.

### Worked example

Before: `GET /api/human/room-send/ready` → 503 `feature_unavailable` (placeholder). After: `createGateway({ registrations: registerHostedProductionRoutes({ env, stores }), absentPrefixes: [], appOrigin })` returns `404 {"code":"not_found","requestId":…}` for it.

The final `hosted-production.ts` body:

```ts
export type HostedProductionOptions = ProductionHumanDependencies;
export function registerHostedProductionRoutes(options: HostedProductionOptions = {}): readonly RouteRegistration[] {
  return Object.freeze([
    ...registerHumanHandlers({ channelLink: () => createHostedHumanChannelLinkRoutes(options) }),
    ...registerAgentHandlers(),
  ]);
}
```

## Test scenarios

`apps/control/src/composition/hosted-production.test.ts`:
1. Covers U6 "each deleted route returns 404". `createGateway({ registrations: registerHostedProductionRoutes({ env, stores }), absentPrefixes: [], appOrigin: origin })`. Each of these, with `GET` (and `POST` with `origin` header and `{}` body for the POST-only ones), returns 404 `not_found`:

   - `/api/human/owner-mailbox/submit`
   - `/api/human/owner-device-proof/challenge`

2. The registered path and method set equals the kept table exactly, health excluded.
3. Results are identical with `KHALA_ADMISSION_MODE` undefined, `'explicit_browser_consent'` and `'bogus'`, and with `PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN` set to `https://preview.example.test`. This proves the mode branch is gone.
4. `GET /api/human/me` without a cookie → 401, which shows the human path is wired.

`apps/control/src/runtime/discover.test.ts`: the pinned manifest equals health plus the nine human routes, and existing structural tests (`:35-174`) still pass.

`apps/control/src/composition/agent/handlers.test.ts`: `registerAgentHandlers()` → `[]`, frozen.

`apps/control/src/channel-link/handler.test.ts`: the human resolve and personal tests pass. There is no `agent` key in `createChannelLinkHandlers`' result.

## Risks and stop conditions

- Step 1 finds a live importer in `agent-join/` or `apps/web/src`: stop and report the file and line.
- `pnpm typecheck` newly fails (compared with the base run) in a file outside `apps/control` and the three e2e files: stop and report it. Do not widen the deletion; KM-124 owns `tests/`. Untypechecked `tests/integration/{closure-live.ts,owner-revocation-live.ts,recovery/*}` and `tests/e2e/security/inventory.ts` (imports `apps/internal`, `packages/agent-cli`) are KM-102/KM-124's; leave them.
- KM-130 has already merged edits to `matrix.ts` or `handlers.ts`: rebase, keep its edits, and delete around them.
- The human browser spec fails on a call to a deleted route: stop. KM-120 should have removed that call. Report the path.
- Earlier drafts listed KM-133 as `serializes_with`; it is a dependent of this ticket, so roster v2 drops the edge.
- `discover.ts` selects the hosted composition only when the agent module exists. Do not delete `composition/agent/handlers.ts`, and do not change `renderGeneratedFunction`.

## Complexity rationale

3: a large but mechanical deletion (about 90 files), with four kept files that need surgical edits. The risks are the hidden discovery coupling, the shared harness KM-131 and KM-132 copy, and parallel edits by KM-130 and KM-133. All of them are pinned above.
